recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片被一片單調、大小相近的中型母細胞佔滿，核圓、細胞質極少，正常造血細胞幾乎不見；右側可見被推擠破裂的細胞（smudge）拉出染色質。
features: Monotonous sheet of medium-sized blasts effacing normal hematopoiesis
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Homogeneous fine chromatin; nucleoli not resolvable at this magnification
Crushed/smudged cells with streaming chromatin at the right edge
Interspersed red cells distorted by smear preparation
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification shows a monotonous, densely packed population of medium-sized blasts with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with near-complete replacement of normal maturing elements. Crushed cells with streaming chromatin are present along the right side of the field. Granules and Auer rods cannot be assessed reliably at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Shares the monotonous high N:C appearance; distinguished only by lymphoid lineage markers with negative MPO.
Higher-power review may reveal Auer rods or fine granules and MPO positivity in the blasts.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clumps or rosettes and are CD45-negative, whereas leukemic blasts are discohesive and CD45-positive.
